clips.name: match-968-menu-sequence
clips.description: Match 968 first 60s: the original failure case. The session navigates CLUB management → PLAYER LOADOUTS hub → loadout detail → WORLD OF CHEL splash before entering a lobby. v1 mis-classified the first 3 spans as pre_game_lobby_state_2, contaminating the typed lobby extractor. v2 must classify these correctly OR fall back to unknown_or_transition for the two deferred classes.
_operator_workflow: Watch the clip frame-by-frame (e.g. `ffplay clip-match968-menu-sequence.mkv` or extract 1-fps thumbnails with `ffmpeg -i clip-match968-menu-sequence.mkv -vf fps=1 t%02d.png`).
For each contiguous span of frames showing the same screen, append a {t_start_sec, t_end_sec, expected, notes} entry.
Valid `expected` values (must match game_ocr nhl26.yaml states):
player_loadout_view (HOME/AWAY side strip + single-player loadout panels)
Two extra labels are RELAXED for deferred classes (see deferred_classes_relaxed above):
menu_club_management   — single-team CLUB panel; v2 may classify as unknown_or_transition
player_loadout_landing — PLAYER LOADOUTS hub (grid of cards, no HOME/AWAY strip); same allowance
Once labels are populated, the proving-bench test will start gating this clip. Hard zero pre_game_lobby_state_2 predictions over the CLUB/loadout/WoC spans is also asserted.
